숲 건너에 사촌들이 와 있대.\n밥만 주면 밤에 싸워 준대.\n…다 내:
Cousins are just across the forest.
They'll fight at night for a meal.
...Not all cousins, some friends too.
Bring them. We'll use them tonight.
헤헤, 표식만 놓으면 와!\n밤에 땅에 놓기만 해.\n셋, 넷은 금방이야:
Heh, just set down a marker!
Put it on the ground at night.
Three or four come in no time.
…그, 그치? 내가 최고지!\n크흠. 사촌들이 보낸 동전이야.\n밥값 아:
...R-right? I'm the best!
Ahem. Coins from the cousins.
Saved on meals, they said.
I'll stand in front again tonight.
...With cousins pushing from behind.
할아버지 호루라기야.\n불면 졸개들이 온대.\n…무서워서 한 번도 안 불:
It's Grandpa's whistle.
Blow it and the minions come.
...I never blew it. Too scary.
삐익―! …와, 진짜 온다!\n고블린 목에 걸어 줘.\n셋까지는 따라올:
Fweeee! ...Wow, they're really coming!
Hang it on the goblin's neck.
They'll follow for up to three.
...You're kind, Boss.
Then this is a thank-you.
A few coins.
Someday I'll blow it.
Loud, like Grandpa.
이 냄비, 투구로 딱이야.\n찌그러지면 매일 아침 펴면 돼.\n고블린은:
This pot makes a perfect helmet.
When it dents, just bend it back each morning.
That's how goblins live.
Here you go!
Blocks up to five hits.
Goblins just keep bending it back.
Don't look down on pots!
...Fine, I'll sell it and pay you in coins.
Hmph.
If you hear pot clanging tonight,
that's me.
주머니에서 이게 나왔어.\n흔들면 쉭쉭 소리가 나.\n…불 붙이면 어떻게:
Found this in my pocket.
Shake it and it hisses.
...What if we light it?
펑! 할 거야, 아마!\n가까이 있는 친구는… 조심해.\n가끔 우리 쪽으:
Boom! Probably!
Friends nearby... be careful.
Sometimes it bounces back at us.
당장 물에 담가!: Put it in water right now!
Aw, fine...
Here, what I tidied from my pocket.
Some of it's useful.
주머니엔 아직 많아.\n다음엔 더 큰 걸로!:
My pockets still have plenty.
Next time, bigger!
주머니가 너무 무거워.\n반은 버려야 하는데…\n주인이 가져갈래?:
My pockets are so heavy.
I should toss half...
Want to take it, Boss?
Here's a whole sack!
I don't know what's inside.
If it's metal... sell it.
Oh, never thought of that!
I'll share what's left after selling.
Here, coins.
So light now!
Time to pick up more.
반짝이는 걸 보면 다들 멈춰.\n나도, 까마귀도, 괴물도.\n그걸로 뭘:
Everyone stops at something shiny.
Me, crows, monsters.
What can we do with it?
유리구슬을 잔뜩 붙였어.\n던지면 다 몰려와.\n그리고… 펑, 눈이 부셔:
I stuck on lots of glass beads.
Throw it and they all swarm.
Then... boom, blinding light!
헤헤, 노력할게.\n대신 이거, 주운 동전.\n반짝이지?:
Heh, I'll try.
Here, a coin I found.
Shiny, right?
이 톱 봐, 이 톱!\n고물로도 울타리를 금방 세워.\n…2일이면 무너지:
Look at this saw, this saw!
Even scrap builds a fence fast.
...It falls in two days, though.
Just one timber!
Up fast, down fast.
Goblin style.
Hmph, Master Craftsman has arrived.
Then take the leftover planks.
Use them well.
The saw gleams again today!
...Ah, mind my fingers.
졸개가 다섯이면 한 마리 몫,\n열이면… 셈이 안 돼.\n한꺼번에 몰면:
Five minions make one beast's worth,
ten... I can't count.
Herd them together and it's easy!
하나, 둘… 에잇, 다 같이!\n졸개가 많을수록 세게 박아.\n없으면 못:
One, two... oh, all together!
The more minions, the harder the hit.
With none, it's useless.
Counting one by one is better.
...True, count one by one.
I counted coins while at it.
Here, exactly six.
Tonight I'll count
all the minions.
덫을 셋 놨는데 넷이 걸렸어.\n…하나가 두 번 밟았나 봐.\n산장에도:
I set three traps and four got caught.
...Maybe one was stepped on twice.
Shall I set one at the lodge too?
Set one in front of the lodge.
셋! 정확히 셋.\n터지면 내가 새벽에 다시 놓을게.\n고블린이 있으면:
Three! Exactly three.
If one springs, I'll reset it at dawn.
If a goblin's around, that is.
Then take what got caught.
Today's meat.
...The fourth one's a secret.
Count the traps, and count again.
That's my job.
니브 아저씨가 맡긴 문서야.\n서명하면 고블린 하나가 바로 와.\n대신:
Uncle Niv left this note.
Sign it and a goblin comes right away.
But it's due in three days.
좋아! 바로 계약 카드 줄게.\n3일 뒤 새벽에 %dG.\n못 갚으면…:
Good! Here's the contract card.
%dG at dawn in three days.
If you can't pay... that one leaves.
…지금 올 수 있는 고블린이 없대.\n문서는 내가 갖고 있을게.\n다음에:
...No goblin can come right now.
I'll keep the note.
I'll ask again later.
Rrrip.
Don't tell Uncle Niv.
...He'll probably know.
Debt is scary.
Goblins know it too.
사촌의 사촌이 일을 찾는대.\n내일 오라고 할까?\n대신 오늘 먹을 걸:
My cousin's cousin is looking for work.
Shall I say come tomorrow?
Just share some food today.
Thanks, Boss!
They'll definitely come tomorrow.
I'll bring the food myself.
Okay...
Here's a coin from the cousin.
They're sorry.
The more goblins the better.
...Though they eat more.
이 산장엔 값나가는 게 꽤 굴러다녀요.\n다들 그냥 밟고 지나가더군요.\:
Plenty of valuable things lie around this Lodge.
Everyone just steps over them.
How to count gold, or how to spot goods. Which one?
Wise of you.
Coins never lie.
Please hold this scale.
오, 안목이 있으시군요.\n고물 속에 보물이 있는 법이죠.\n이 안경을:
Oh, a good eye.
Treasure hides in scrap.
Please put these spectacles on.
An eye that knows value
is not easily fooled.
